_comment: After each deploy, call the version() and get_wasm_hash() entrypoints via simulation and record the results in deployedVersion and deployedWasmHash. Alert if deployedVersion does not match expectedVersion, or if deployedWasmHash does not match expectedWasmHash.

contracts.name: niffyinsure
contracts.notes: Testnet deployment. Set CONTRACT_ID_TESTNET env var. Run `sha256sum niffyinsure.wasm` after each build. After deploy, invoke `get_wasm_hash()` and compare it with `expectedWasmHash`, then record the deployed version in deployedVersion and the returned hash in deployedWasmHash.

contracts.name: niffyinsure
contracts.notes: Mainnet deployment. CONTRACT_ID_MAINNET is REQUIRED at startup — server refuses to start without it. After deploy, invoke `get_wasm_hash()` and compare it with `expectedWasmHash`, then record the deployed version in deployedVersion and the returned hash in deployedWasmHash. Alert if deployedVersion != expectedVersion or deployedWasmHash != expectedWasmHash.

contracts.name: niffyinsure
contracts.notes: Futurenet deployment. Set CONTRACT_ID_FUTURENET env var. After deploy, invoke `get_wasm_hash()` and compare it with `expectedWasmHash`, then record the deployed version in deployedVersion and the returned hash in deployedWasmHash.
